(pa)༄༅/ /tshogs 'khor bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bdud rtsi bum pa zhes bya ba/bla ma dam pa

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// tshogs 'khor bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bdud rtsi bum pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis tshogs rab rdzogs gyur cing*// yon tan tshogs kyis che ba'i sku// mi zad 'khor lo gsum bdag nyid// 'khor lo'i 'dren par phyag 'tshal lo// bskal ba rgya mtshor 'grub dka' ba'i// bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gang gis bde blag 'grub byed pa'i// tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dir bshad bya// thabs dang shes rab tshogs pa yi// bde chen rol pas tshogs gnyis kyis// 'khor lo bskor nas rgyal ba yi// grong du bgrod phyir tshogs 'khor lo// 'di 'dra dman pa thams cad kyi// yul las shin tu 'das pa ste// bde bas byang chub sgrub byed pa// de 'dra rgyud kyi snying po yin// de lta bu'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas gnas khang dben par lha'i rten dang*/ chu bzhi/ me tog spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas te phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ thod par chang la bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar ba nang gi mchod pa dang*/ shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma rnam pa gsum bsham zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu/ maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas rnams dang*/ sha dang chang la sogs pa bza' btung gya nom pa rnams legs par tshogs par bya'o// de nas dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams 'tshogs la/ las kyi slob ma gcig gis phyag 'tshal nas/ tshogs kyi gtso bo la maṇ+ḍal dang me tog dbul/ gzhan rnams so so la'ang phul nas/ phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang*// yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsag bya'i phyir// gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas me tog rnams bsdus te/ gtso bo la dbul/

des kyang bla ma la phul bar bsam zhing*/ cho ga la 'jug par rjes su gnang ba'i don du gsol ba btab nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis gnas khang de mi dmigs par stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i lha'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du mchod rdzas thams cad lha rdzas las grub pas yongs su gang bar bsam/ nang gi mchod pa'ang thod pa chen po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la thams cad kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas lha'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya ste/ de'ang thog mar sdig pa sbyang ba'i don du/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms la yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bar du gcod pa zhi ba'i don du/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ kye'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa gsal bar bsgoms la/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya/ de nas nang mchod kyis mchod pa rnams la gtor la/ a mṛ ta'i sngags kyis ma dag pa bsangs/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsams pa'i ngang las mchod pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i hūm̐ gi yi ge zhu ba las mchod pa rnams ngo bo bzang la rgya che bar bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab par bya ste/ de'ang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsams pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su kye'i rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs la/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje la sogs pas skye mched byin gyis brlab/ ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan pa'i bar rang gis bsgoms pa bzhin du bya/

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu rgyan dang rang gi bla ma tha mi dad du bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi tha mar bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam/ de nas mchod pa bya ste/ mchod pa so so nam mkha'i khams gang bas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas phyi'i mchod pa dbul ba ni sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// de nas nang gi mchod pa ni nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mthe bo dang srin lag gis gtor/ 'thor ba rnams thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba mang por gyur nas so so la mchod par bsam zhing thog mar rang gi bla ma'i mtshan nas smos la dbul/ de nas rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ ga ya dha ra/ rje 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ se mkhar chung ba/ rje dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ bla ma rje btsun pa/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta zhes rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du mtshan rnams kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bla ma brgyud pa rnams la dbul/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sngags brjod cing mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dbul/ de nas yi dam gyi lha gzhan rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la dbul/ de nas rang gi lce dang dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su bdud rtsis reg cing rang gi lus kyi lha rnams mchod/ de nas shrī ma hā kā lā ya zhes pas chos skyong la/ ma hā kā li de wī oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lha mo la/ de nas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa bzhes oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang*/ dur khrod kyi bdag po phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa bzhes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbul/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/

phyogs skyong ba bcu/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams mchod pa bzhes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbul/ de nas gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams tshim par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la sbyin no// nang gi mchod pa'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i yid las byung ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa bya ste/ de'ang dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin zhes pa la sogs pa brjod cing*/ sems kyis lha mo de dag gis mchod par bsam mo// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bstod par bya ste/ de yang khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /ces pa la sogs pa brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod par bya'o// de dag ni mchod pa'o// de nas gtor ma rnams nang mchod dang chu dang chang gis sbyangs nas/ dang po mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin kye'i rdo rjer gtor ma dbul/ gnyis pa chos skyong la dbul/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul/ de nas bza' btung gi tshogs rnams lhan cig bsags la/ nang mchod kyis gtor nas bsang ba dang sbyang ba dang byin gyis brlab pa gtor ma rgyas pa ltar bya/ yang nang mchod blugs shing gtor bas thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du ro gcig par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang ha ho hrīḥzhes yang yang brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thog mar ma da na'i phud bla ma dang dkyil 'khor dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs la dbul/ de nas ba la la sogs pa bza' ba'i phud dbul/ de'ang a ho su kha zhes brjod/ de nas gtor ma la ma da na dang ba la dbul zhing*/ so so'i sngags kyis bstabs so// de'i rjes su las kyi slob ma gcig gis tshogs kyi gtso bo la phyag 'tshal nas/

rnam lnga 'dod pa bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'du ba rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*// rang bzhin gcig la nyid du bzhes// a ho su kha zhes brjod nas ma da na dbul/ len pa pos kyang phyag rgya bya zhing*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// a ho su kha zhes brjod cing blang*/ de nas gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin du drang zhing blang ngo*// de bzhin du zas gzhan rnams kyang*/ a ho su kha zhes brjod cing drang*/ len pa pos kyang a ho su kha zhes brjod cing blang ngo*// de nas nang mchod kyi mchod pa'i skabs bzhin du phud kyis mchod/ de nas rang gi lte ba'i nang du gtum mo'i me sbar bas lus gang*/ snying gar lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bla ma dang bcas pa/ lte bar 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bsams nas/ de rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad/ las kyi slob mas dam tshig ma thob kyi bar la gzhan rnams kyis snod thang la mi gzhag tshogs kyi gtso bos longs ma spyad par gzhan rnams longs mi spyad/ tshogs 'khor ma tshar gyi bar la snod stong par mi gzhag der 'dus pa'i gang zag rnams la bzang ngan dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bza' btung la gtsang mi gtsang gi rnam rtog mi bya/ rab tu myos pa'i chang mi btung*/ chags sdang gi gtam mi bya/ kha shags dang rtsod pa mi bya/ kha zas la bdud rtsi'i 'du shes dang*/ rang la dkyil 'khor gyi 'du shes dang*/ longs spyad pa la lha mchod pa'i 'du shes yang dang yang du gsal gdab cing*/ thams cad 'khor gsum yongs su dag par dran par bya'o// yo byad rnams la brda'i ming nas smos par bya ste/ chang la ma da na/ sha la ba la/ kha zas la kri pi ta/ thug pa la ma la tin+dha naṃ/ snod la pad+ma bhañdza na/ zhes brjod kyi phal pa'i skad kyis mi brjod/

go skabs yod cing sems spro na glu dang gar gyis lha dang bla mar mchod/ lhag ma ma bsdus kyi bar du mi 'gro/ 'gro dgos na bla ma'am grogs la dris la/ yang nang du 'jug byin gyis brlabs pa'i kha zas dbang ma thob pa la mi sbyin/ gal te ster dgos na lhag gtor gyi sngags kyis lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la bsngos la sbyin/ de ltar bza' btung gis tshim pa dang*/ snying gar ma da na'i thig le byas la he ru ka yab yum du gsal bar dmigs nas/ snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen pos lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing bde ba bsgom mo// de nas lhag ma rnams bsdus la tshogs kyi gtso bo'i mdun du bzhag nas/ ma da na'i kha phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya byas pa'i nang nas bh+rūm̐ zhes brjod la gtor bas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la mngon sum ltar dmigs la de rnams la sbyin par bsam zhing oṃ a kā ro'i sngags gsum mam bdun gyi mthar/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba lin+ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā zhes gsum mam lngas bsngos pas 'byung po rnams tshim par bsam/ de nas mkha' 'gro rnams mnyes shing dngos grub blang ba dang byin dbab pa'i don du rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ kol+la i reṭaṭhi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kṛ pi ṭa ho bādz+dza i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dzā i/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza i/ ha le kā liñdza ra pā ṇi a i/ dun+dur bīdz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī sih+lā/ kā b+bur lā i a i/ mā la in+dha ṇa sā liñdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhe na mu ṇi a i/ ni rāṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun+du ru bā ṭā i/ ḍin+ḍi ma ta hin+na bādz+dzi a i/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blang ngo*// de nas phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/

zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas pa'i mthar/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las/ phyogs dus kun du rgyal bar gyur cig ces bkra shis brjod do// de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dngos grub blang ba'i bsam pas bdag gi phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsal du gsol zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa gsol ba gdab bo// de nas cho ga lhag chad kha bskang ba'i don du yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces brjod nas yo byad dman pa dang*/ cho ga lhag chad bzod par gsol zhes brjod do// de nas las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan pa bya ba'i don du bsngo ba ni/ thal mo sbyar nas don bsam zhing*/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// zhes pa la sogs pa'i mthar/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /gnas skabs su tshe ring ba dang nad med pa dang bar chad zhi ba dang bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo// de nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ dngos su yod na gshegs su gsol mi dgos/ gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ med na mdun bskyed dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// yi ge brgya pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod de rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol bar bsam mo// dam tshig pa rnams/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bdag la bsdu'o// de nas grib gnon gyi gdon mi 'byung bar bya ba'i don du gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs te/ drag po'i sngags brjod cing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar gtang*/ de nas rang gi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brjod cing bsams la bdag nyid bsrung*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// de ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas pa'i phan yon ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams mnyes nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ yan lag gi dam tshig gi nyes pa rnams 'dag pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi thugs dang 'gal ba rnams zhi zhing mnyes par 'gyur ba dang*/ bdag nyid kyi rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin brtan par byed cing*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed de/ mdor na gnas skabs su bar chad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro// sems dang lus gnyis sku gnyis su// gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa'i don// dbang dang lam gyis gsal byas pa// mchod pa'i yul ni bla na med// rnyed sla nus ldan rgyal ba yi// rigs dang nyer 'brel rtog 'joms pas// stobs lnga mi 'chi bcu phyed dang*// chang ni mchod rdzas bla na med// rnam g.yeng rnam par zhi 'gyur zhing*// lha yi tshogs kyang 'du ba dang*// dben zhing ting 'dzin dag kyang gsal// de phyir mtshan mo bla med dus// dka' spyad gdung ba'i sdug bsngal med// de nyid shes phyir sdang zhen bral// longs spyod bde bas ye shes bskyed// spyod pa 'di 'dra bla na med// ji ltar dug dang de bzhin mtshon// rgyal po'i stobs dang chu la lcags// de bzhin de ni me la rlung*// phan gnod ji ltar byed pa ltar// gang zhig gang gis gang 'ching ba// de yi de nyid yongs shes na// de nyid kyis de grol bar byed// gang phyir sems nyid gtso bo'i phyir// gsang ba'i tshul chen bla na med// klog dang sgrub pa mang mod kyi// rigs pas grub pa'i sgrub pa ni// smra ba gzhan su yin pa smros// de phyir yang dag lam bsten nas// yang dag grub par bsgrub 'dod pas// lung dang rigs pa yang dag par// rtogs pa'i yang dag bshes gnyen bsten// rigs gzugs dpal 'byor phun tshogs shing*// dad dang shes rab phul byung ba// lha sras jim gyim gsung gis ni// yang dang yang du rab bskul bas// zab yangs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i don// rnam dpyod srub shing gis bsrubs nas// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga yi// bdud rtsi'i bum pa bdag gis bsgrubs// dge ba de yis 'gro kun gyis// bdud rtsi 'di ni legs myangs nas// srid pa'i zug rngu legs byang ste// 'chi med dam pa thob par shog

/dpal kye'i rdo rje'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i bum pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos len pa/ 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas/ sa pho rta'i lo smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyi shu lnga la rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang chen por sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
